lines.t: (Verse 1)
I look at the stars and I’m shaking
How the Maker of all knows my name
You saw me before I was breathing
And You loved me despite all the shame
And all that I have is a vapor
Just a ghost in the palm of Your hand
I’m done with the masks and the hiding
I’m just trying to learn where I stand
(Pre-Chorus)
(Bass guitar builds, subtle floor tom hits)
It’s a weight I can’t carry alone
It’s a frequency I’ve never known
(Chorus)
And I don’t want the world to define me
‘Cause I don’t think they’d ever understand
That when I am lost and I’m broken
I’m resting in just Who You are
I’m resting in just Who You are
(Yeah, I'm resting in just Who You are)
(Verse 2)
And you can’t fight the grace when it hits you
Like a fever that breaks in the light
When the static is finally fading
You’re the morning that kills off the night
And I try to describe what I’m feeling
But the words always get in the way
The world is just spinning in circles
While I’m looking for something to say
(Chorus)
And I don’t want the world to define me
‘Cause I don’t think they’d ever understand
That when I am lost and I’m broken
I’m resting in just Who You are
(Bridge)
[Instrumental Break: Heavy distorted guitar solo - messy and loud]
I’m found in the way that You know me
I’m found in the way that You know me
I’m found in the way that You know me
In the silence, I am finally seen
(Outro)
[Acoustic guitar and Cello only]
You know me better than I do
Yeah, You know me better than I do
I’m resting in just Who You are...
[End]
